title.description: Name of the thing being shared, shown in the panel title as Share "title".

link.description: The URL shown in the link row and written to the clipboard by Copy.

people.description: Recent people: { id, name, avatar }. Picking one flies its avatar up into the Send to row.

channels.description: Channel buttons: { id, label, icon, doneLabel }. doneLabel is shown once onChannel resolves; keep it about as long as label.

access.description: Access levels: { value, label, description, icon } (the type was ShareAccess, kept as a deprecated alias). Shown in a listbox under the link.

defaultAccess.description: Starting access value. Defaults to the first entry in access.

onSend.description: Receives { people, access }. A returned promise holds the sending state; a rejection keeps the panel open with an error.

onChannel.description: Called with the channel id. A promise holds that button's pending state; a rejection shows Failed on it.

onCopy.description: Called after the link is copied, with the access level it was copied under.

align.description: Which edge of the button stays put while the panel grows. center grows it evenly around the button and folds it back the same way.

sheetOnPhones.description: Up to 520px wide the panel opens as a bottom sheet over a dimmed backdrop: it slides up, drags down from its grabber, and closes on Esc, a tap outside or Done.
